_source: SIA 263:2013, Tabelle 5a «Schlankheitskriterien für beidseitig gestützte Scheiben» and Tabelle 5b «Schlankheitskriterien für einseitig gestützte Scheiben», with the Beulwerte k1, k2 and the factor epsilon, p. 26 (clause 4.3.1, Tabelle 4 p. 24) -- read off a render of SIA263-2013-DE.pdf p. 26 on 12.10.2026: the tables are graphics and their formulas do not extract as text (spec 2026-10-12-section-acier, REQ-005). The only copy of these values in the project.
_note: Each limit is max b/t = coefficient · epsilon, epsilon = sqrt(235/f_y). The rows with a formula in alpha or psi write it as {kind, coefficient}: 'alpha_internal' 396 epsilon/(13 alpha − 1) (alpha >= 0.5), 'alpha_inv' 36 epsilon/alpha (alpha <= 0.5), 'alpha_inv_15' 9 epsilon/alpha^1.5, 'psi_internal' 42 epsilon/(0.67 + 0.33 psi) (psi > −1), 'psi_tension' 62 epsilon (1 − psi) sqrt(−psi) (psi <= −1), 'sqrt_k1' and 'sqrt_k2' 21 epsilon sqrt(k). alpha is the compressed part of the plate, psi the ratio of the edge stresses, compression positive. The internal plate's b is the figure's: between the root radii of a rolled section, h − 3 t of a hollow section (1.5 t at each corner); the outstand's b from the root of the fillet to the free edge. The table's own epsilon for S235/S275/S355/S460 (1.0, 0.924, 0.814, 0.715) is kept as a check of the formula, not used.
